### Added

- Add `idPrefix` to `GinkoMarkdown`: it puts a prefix before every id and `#` link of one body, so a page that shows several bodies has no duplicate ids. The docs changelog uses it with each release's anchor. ([#34](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/34))
- Add `NUXT_PUBLIC_GINKO_NOINDEX=true`, which keeps a whole deployment out of search, its own address included. Use it for demos and for a site that runs on a preview address before its domain switch: robots.txt then disallows everything and every response sends `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`. Site responses now also send `Permissions-Policy: camera=(), geolocation=(), microphone=()`. ([#34](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/34))

### Changed

- Change the generated share card of a page with an image to JPEG. As PNG such a card weighed 400-700 KB, and WhatsApp drops preview images over about 300 KB. Cards without an image stay PNG. ([#34](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/34))
